invideo AI: Best for fast script-to-video workflow and stock media assembly. You type a prompt or upload media, and it handles scriptwriting, voiceovers, scene transitions, and captions. invideo AI
Canva Video Ad Maker (Magic Studio): Best for quick, template-based social media ads with built-in brand kits and drag-and-drop editing. Canva
